Yes, you can make a baby with my daughters and get everything here.” Though Daisuke still can’t believe it, he starts staying at her house. Erotic and deep relationship with the sisters. What is the secret of this house? What will happen to Daisuke?

あらすじ

There is a magic school located on a southern island, where female students learn magic hard every day. Fran, Chloe, and Nathalia…. They are going to graduate from school next year, but they haven’t mastered how to call a familiar spirit. Their grades aren’t bad, but they somehow can’t call it. One day, they decide to call a familiar spirit together, but it fails again…. When they are disappointed, they find a naked boy lying in front of them. “Who is he…?” It’s Rio. He seems to have been called by the girls…. He, who doesn’t remember the things before he is called, starts living with the girls…. Who will Rio make a contract with? Where is Rio from? Their busy and H school life now begins…!

There is a city called Glaciest at the northern edge of the continent. The city is famous for a mysterious phenomenon in which people’s dream realizes and a crystallized dream called Evil Ice Stone. Glaciest is always full of people who come to see the stone or to investigate the phenomenon. Also, there is a rumor that a lot of treasures are hidden inside a tower, Horn of Revelia, and the top of the tower is connected to a promised land, Eternal Paradise. Allion is a member of a special group that is organized to mediate wars between countries. One day, he and his company are ordered to visit Glaciest. With different purposes in their minds, their adventure now starts….

The story takes place in a fantasy world where magic is commonplace. The protagonist, a young boy named Tsukasa, gains the power to make women lustful with just a glance after a certain event. Under the guidance of his mentor, an old wizard, Tsukasa studies magic in order to control this troublesome power. One day, he meets a beautiful sorceress named Sylvia, who helps him gain admission to an all-girls magic academy. Tsukasa strives to learn how to control his power while attending the academy.

item.title: Serina
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Atelier Kaguya TEAM HEARTBEAT
  • 発売日: 2004-07-23
  • スコア: 7.01/10 (42 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 瀬里奈
  • 英語名: Serina

あらすじ

A curious young man named Kousaka Naoto is studying folklore at university. One day in July, just before a long summer vacation, he receives a letter from his missing mentor. Intrigued by the contents of the letter, Naoto decides to visit the infamous Kamimori village as part of his fieldwork. The village is located deep in the mountains and can only be reached by a bus that runs once a day. On the bus, Naoto meets a beautiful girl named Suou Serina, who was born in Kamimori but left the village as a child due to a certain incident. Serina and Naoto stay at the Suou residence, and as they spend more time together, their relationship gradually grows closer.
